name: A Chance Encounter
source:
Shackled to the wheel of an abandoned cart, this hopeless, handsome rogue is in need of a helping hand. Is he compelling enough to be released, or are you so cruel as to leave him to his fate?

[From [url=https://fiendishfiction.itch.io/chance]itch.io[/url]]
